title: no autocorrect identity fields
rule: Do not autocorrect names, addresses, or emails; turn spellcheck off on emails, codes, and usernames.

citation.source: NN/g — A Checklist for Designing Mobile Input Fields; Vercel Web Interface Guidelines

pass_when: Name, address, email: autocorrect off. Email, code, username: spellcheck off.
fail_when: Those fields autocorrect or spellcheck as prose.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
